items.q: What should you remember about **Strategic vs tactical**?
items.a: **John Ousterhout framing; delegate** tactical to AI fleet, keep roadmap/product/architecture human-owned.

items.q: What should you remember about **Teach skill live demo**?
items.a: **vibe coder mission → Git lesson one** with quizzes; stateful workspace (mission.md, learning record, HTML); install via npx skills add mattpocock/skills.

items.q: What should you remember about **Grill Me**?
items.a: **~4 sentences; interview until shared** understanding before implementation; list 10 consequential decisions and ask until 98% clarity.

items.q: What should you remember about **Skill context leak**?
items.a: **every ability skill description leaks** into context; 100 skills = 100 descriptions; prefer user-only procedures.

items.q: What should you remember about **Knowledge / skills / wisdom**?
items.a: **skills repo bundles first** two; wisdom needs real context (can't fully proceduralize Anthropic-level judgment).

items.q: What should you remember about **Sand Castle**?
items.a: **sandboxed parallel Claude Code;** GitHub Actions for explore/implement/review labels on issues.

items.q: What should you remember about **Model skepticism**?
items.a: **Fable computer-use impressive but** human still validates; daily security cron beats one-shot frontier finds.

items.q: What should you remember about **DX vs AX**?
items.a: **agent experience overlaps good developer** experience; seniors improve codebase for agents; juniors bring harness fluency.

items.q: What should you remember about **Business unchanged**?
items.a: talk to customers, build prototypes; AI helps implementation not idea generation; ask AI what to **remove**.

items.q: What should you remember about **Context bloat reset**?
items.a: **blank slate test before accumulating skills/MCP again.**
